Contents 1 Why is this alert issued? 2 Who issues it? 3 Where can I see it? 4 Examples 4.1 Text Example 5 References Why is this alert issued?[] A Freeze Watch is issued in the autumn until the end of the growing season (marked by the occurrence of first widespread freeze). The normal end of the growing season is mid to late October west of the Blue Ridge and early November east of the Blue Ridge. However, during anomalously warm autumns, the growing season may be extended past the normal end of the growing season. A Freeze Watch is issued in the spring at the start of the growing season (when it is late enough to cause damage to new plants and crops).[1] Who issues it?[] A Freeze Watch is issued by the National Weather Service. In Canada, they are issued by the Meteorological Service of Canada. Where can I see it?[] You can only see it in Canada when it's reported. In the United States, you can only see it on weather.gov. Examples[] Text Example[] URGENT - WEATHER MESSAGE National Weather Service Jacksonville FL 244 PM EST Wed Feb 19 2025 GAZ132>136-149-151>153-162-163-165-250-264-350-364-200900- /O.CON.KJAX.FZ.A.0014.250221T0400Z-250221T1500Z/ Coffee-Jeff Davis-Bacon-Appling-Wayne-Atkinson-Pierce-Brantley- Inland Glynn-Echols-Clinch-Inland Camden-Northern Ware- Northeastern Charlton-Southern Ware-Western Charlton- Including the cities of Baxley, Woodbine, St. George, Thalmann, Statenville, Needham, Waverly, Homeland, Hickox, Hazlehurst, Jesup, Pine Grove, Needmore, Hoboken, Waynesville, Nahunta, Alma, Willacoochee, Hortense, Douglas, Axson, Plant Hatch, Colesburg, Doctortown, Raybon, Folkston, Stephen Foster State Park, Pearson, New Lacy, Tarboro, Race Pond, Homerville, Atkinson, Blackshear, Gardi, Winokur, and Waycross 244 PM EST Wed Feb 19 2025 ...FREEZE WATCH REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY EVENING THROUGH FRIDAY MORNING... * WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 25 possible. * WHERE...Inland portions of southeast Georgia. * WHEN...From Thursday evening through Friday morning. * IMPACTS...Appropriate action should be taken to ensure tender vegetation and outdoor pets have adequate protection from the cold temperatures. Young children, the elderly and the homeless are especially vulnerable to the cold. Take measures to protect them. PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS... Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold. && $$ References[] ↑ https://www.weather.gov/lwx/warningsdefined#Freeze%20Watch Community content is available under CC-BY-SA unless otherwise noted.
